<div class="enthusia-wiki">
<h2>Private messages</h2><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><tbody><tr><td><code>/msg &lt;player&gt; &lt;message&gt;</code></td><td>Send a private message. Aliases include <code>/w</code>, <code>/tell</code> and <code>/whisper</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/r &lt;message&gt;</code></td><td>Reply to the player you most recently messaged or who most recently messaged you. Alias: <code>/reply</code>.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/msgtoggle</code></td><td>Toggle private messages.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/ignore &lt;player&gt;</code></td><td>Ignore chat/messages from a player.</td></tr></tbody></table>
<h2>Channels</h2><p><code>/channel</code> (alias <code>/c</code>) handles chat channels. Guild chat uses <code>/gc</code>; ally chat uses <code>/gac</code> or <code>/ga</code>. Temporary party chat uses <code>/partychat</code> or <code>/pc</code>.</p>
<h2>Formatting and preferences</h2><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><tbody><tr><td><code>/chatcolor</code></td><td>Manage available chat colors.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/colorcodes</code></td><td>View supported color codes.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/emoji</code> / <code>/emojis</code></td><td>View available emoji.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/togglesound</code></td><td>Toggle supported chat notification sounds.</td></tr></tbody></table>
</div>
